title: Add the quest question record and its ask, answer, withdraw, list and view commands (seq 179a)
description:
opum-doc seq 179 (ODOC-OP-2026-10-03-10), the operator's approval of constitution Articles 4 and 5 as amended. 0.14.0 work, item (a), relayed by opum-agent.

The design is opum-doc's docs/reference/questions-decisions-and-adrs.md and docs/reference/operator-questions-in-quest-design.md, both on opum-doc main. Read them there; this record exists so the item is tracked, not to restate them.

In outline: a `question` record with the full command set -- ask, answer, withdraw, list and view -- and a `via` field recording how an answer arrived. Workers implement exactly what the design says and report issues to opum-doc; they make no design calls.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The question record and its ask, answer, withdraw, list and view commands behave as the opum-doc design specifies
The via field records how an answer arrived, as the design defines it
The machine contract for each new command is documented and its envelope conforms

plan: 1. Domain: Question record type + zod schema + id/validators (src/domain/questions/questions.ts).
2. Port + adapter: QuestionRepository and LocalQuestionRepository, one file per record at .quest/questions/Q-N.json.
3. Application: QuestionService with ask/answer/withdraw/list/view; answer requires --actor-kind human; via recorded from input.
4. CLI: quest question ask|answer|withdraw|list|view dispatch in main.ts + refs-aware nextQuestionId; wire createQuestionService in composition.ts.
5. Contract: manifest name union + entries (command-contract.ts), help entries (command-help.ts), update the manifest golden in test/contract/command-contract.test.ts.
6. Tests: round-trip ask/answer/withdraw/list/view; answer requires human actor; via field; then full check.
